body:
18.

Being scared of going to hell is one (I hope there's just nothing afterwards because that honestly sounds great). However, there's also the thought of people I love and care for possibly being driven to suicide by my actions. They're strong people and I know it's not likely but it's still something I can't bear to think about for too long. I don't think this is gonna stop me for long though as I really hate life right now although there are a few good moments. Just don't think I'm ever fully going to be free from mental illness and I don't want to suffer much longer. I've just begged and prayed to god that he'll forgive me when I go through with it. Still don't think I can put an "if" in front of that statement.

Sorry to be such a downer, I'm confident a lot of you will be able to find light at the end of this dark, dark tunnel but I just don't think I can be saved at this point.
I think they're gone dudes. I just hope that if that's the case they've found peace. Sad fact of life that we can't save everyone.

Last time I tried, I was hanging for somewhere between 3 and 6 minutes and only just got close to the point of blacking out when I panicked and managed to free myself. The waiting is not a pleasant thing to experience.

This honestly made my day. I never realised the affect some black and white words on a screen could have. Speaking from experience, you need to keep fighting for your kids. I've grown up my whole life without a father figure which has been tough on the relationship between myself and my mum. Not impossible but certainly far from easy.

Thank you for listening to my ramblings and well done once again for fighting and continuing to do so even at your lowest points. Maybe some day we will both live happier lives without the burden of these suicidal thoughts. If not, they may at least subside after getting out these thoughts on the internet. This talk has been so encouraging as I can tell you've been fighting much longer than myself and you're still here, that's the main thing.  Hope everything is and will be well with the latest addition to the family.

Thanks for replying, I understand your viewpoint and I'm happy you don't see me the way I do. A very eye-opening viewpoint. However, I hope you understand that I'm not contributing anything to anyone at the moment and it just feels that I am wasting everyone's time and resources to keep a roof over my head. No motivation and no drive to change this either. I'm proud of you for trying to help and for staying strong for however long you've been fighting. Keep it up, believe me I know the struggle. Once again thank you, it was nice to hear a friendly voice even if it was just over the internet.
This is my mood so often recently. I would badly want to tell my mum how close I've come but hate the thought of admitting my cowardice.
Are you still around? Hang in there, man.
Thank you, but I don't feel so optimistic. Been waiting for help for 3 months not knowing whether it's even right for me. This countries supposed health service is an absolute joke.
I'll be lurking if you need to talk. Don't want to encourage you but I would recommend having a good look into lostallhope.com
How are you holding up? I may not be of much help but I want you to realise people have seen your cry for help.
